frontal_spatial_matrix.muzzle_spot_diameter: Individual spots on the anterior muzzle are approximately 10-15% of the total pixel area of the nasal pad.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a thick black radio-tracking collar with silver hardware and a projecting antenna on the dorsal neck.
other_distinctive_markers: Pink tongue is partially visible and protruding from the oral cavity; both eyes are closed or heavily squinted during the capture.
